# Mathway

> Mathway is a comprehensive math problem solver offering step-by-step solutions across multiple mathematical disciplines with support for numerous languages and platforms.

Mathway provides instant problem-solving across Basic Math, Algebra, Precalculus, Calculus, Trigonometry, Statistics, Physics, and more. The platform is available as a web application and mobile app, serving students globally with multilingual support and a free graphing calculator tool.

## Key Topics

- Step-by-step solutions
- Math problem solver
- Graphing calculator
- Algebra
- Calculus
- Trigonometry
- Basic Math
- Pre-Algebra
- Physics problem solver
- Mobile app
- Free trial
- Educational tool
- Equation solver
- Multilingual support
- Photo math

## Core Problem Solvers

- [Algebra Problem Solver](https://www.mathway.com/us/Algebra): Algebra problem solver with step-by-step solutions and photo math capabilities
- [Basic Math Problem Solver](https://www.mathway.com/BasicMath): Basic Math problem solver with step-by-step explanations
- [Graphing Calculator](https://www.mathway.com/us/Graph): Free graphing calculator for instant visualization of math problems
- [Calculus Problem Solver](https://www.mathway.com/id/Calculus): Calculus problem solver with step-by-step solutions
- [Trigonometry Problem Solver](https://www.mathway.com/ko/Trigonometry): Trigonometry problem solver with step-by-step explanations
- [Pre-Algebra Problem Solver](https://www.mathway.com/it/PreAlgebra): Pre-Algebra problem solver with step-by-step explanations
- [Physics Problem Solver](https://www.mathway.com/ko/Physics): Physics problem solver with step-by-step solutions

## Multilingual Solvers

- [Algebra Problem Solver (Russian)](https://www.mathway.com/ru/Algebra): Algebra problem solver with step-by-step explanations in Russian
- [Basic Math Problem Solver (Portuguese)](https://www.mathway.com/pt/BasicMath): Basic Math problem solver with step-by-step solutions in Portuguese
- [Graphing Calculator (Portuguese)](https://www.mathway.com/pt/Graph): Graphing calculator for instant math problem visualization in Portuguese
